pair.title: Pairing tool
pair.description: Device details were imported from the Tuya Cloudless pairing tool. Verify that the details are correct and click **Next** to test the connection.

ble_pair.title: BLE Pairing
ble_pair.description:
The pairing tool should open automatically in a new browser tab. Follow the steps there to connect your device over Bluetooth and get your local key.

If the tab did not open, click the button below.

**Requires Chrome or Edge** (desktop or Android) and **HTTPS** — see the [HTTPS setup guide](https://github.com/11z4t/tuya-cloudless/wiki/HTTPS-Setup) if needed.

ble_confirm.title: Device paired successfully
ble_confirm.description: Your device at **{ip_address}** (ID: `{gw_id}`) was paired successfully. Give it a name and select the device type.

data_description.device_name: A friendly name shown in Home Assistant
data_description.profile: Select the type that best matches your device

user.title: Add a Tuya device
user.description: Choose how you want to add your device.

data_description.setup_mode: BLE Pairing is recommended for new devices. Search finds devices already on your network. Manual entry lets you enter details by hand.

select.title: Found {count} device(s)
select.description: Select the device you want to add.

local_key.title: Enter the security key
local_key.description:
Your device at **{ip_address}** (firmware {firmware}) needs a security key to communicate locally.

The key is shown when you pair the device using the [Tuya Cloudless pairing tool]({pairing_tool_url}). It is stored only in Home Assistant — nothing is sent to the cloud.

data_description.device_name: A friendly name shown in Home Assistant (leave empty to use the IP address)
data_description.profile: Select the type that best matches your device

confirm.title: Ready to connect
confirm.description:
**{device_name}** at `{ip_address}` will be added to Home Assistant.

Click **Connect** to test the connection and finish setup.

manual.title: Add device manually
manual.description: Enter the details for your Tuya device. The device ID and security key are shown in the [Tuya Cloudless pairing tool]({pairing_tool_url}).

data_description.gw_id: Unique device identifier (shown during pairing, e.g. abc123def456)
data_description.local_key: 16-character security key from the pairing tool
data_description.ip_address: Device IP address (set a fixed address in your router for best reliability)
data_description.protocol_version: Model 3.3 works for most devices made after 2020
data_description.profile: Select the type that best matches your device

discovery.title: Tuya device found
discovery.description:
A device was detected at **{ip_address}** (firmware {firmware}).

Enter the security key from the [Tuya Cloudless pairing tool]({pairing_tool_url}) to finish setup.

data_description.local_key: 16-character key from the Tuya Cloudless pairing tool

reauth_confirm.title: Update security key
reauth_confirm.description:
The security key for **{device_name}** stopped working. This happens if the device was factory reset or paired again.

Get the new key from the [Tuya Cloudless pairing tool]({pairing_tool_url}) and enter it below to reconnect.

data_description.ip_address: Leave empty if the address has not changed

reconfigure.title: Update connection settings
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address or security key for **{device_name}** without removing and re-adding the device.

data_description.ip_address: Current IP address of the device on your network

ble_fallback.title: HTTPS required for BLE pairing
ble_fallback.description:
**Tuya Cloudless** could not find an HTTPS URL for your Home Assistant. Web Bluetooth requires a secure context (HTTPS).

You can still add a device that is already connected to your network using **Search** or by entering its details manually.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device — check the IP address and that the device is on the same network as Home Assistant
error.invalid_local_key: Invalid security key — must be exactly 16 characters
error.invalid_auth_key: The security key is incorrect. Check the key and try again.
error.invalid_gw_id: Invalid device ID — must not be empty
error.invalid_ip: Invalid IP address — must not be empty
error.auth_failed: Connection refused — the security key may be wrong, or the device was paired again using the Tuya app
error.no_devices_found: No Tuya devices found on your network. Make sure the device is powered on and on the same Wi-Fi. Switch to **Manual** above to enter details by hand.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant log for details
error.invalid_ha_url: Enter a valid address, for example http://homeassistant.local:8123
error.invalid_local_key_chars: Local key contains invalid characters (must be printable ASCII)

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up
abort.not_tuya_device: The device did not respond as expected
abort.pairing_server_unavailable: Could not start the BLE pairing server on port 8099 — the port may be in use. Try again or use Search / Manual setup instead.
abort.https_required: Tuya Cloudless requires HTTPS for BLE pairing. Your Home Assistant does not have an HTTPS URL configured. See the [HTTPS setup guide](https://github.com/11z4t/tuya-cloudless/wiki/HTTPS-Setup).
abort.reauth_successful: Security key updated — the device is connected again
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings updated — the device is reloading
abort.no_device_id: Could not identify the device — make sure it is powered on and connected to the network

device_unavailable.message: Device is unavailable — the connection is down

command_timeout.message: Command did not reach the device within the timeout — please try again

send_failed.message: Failed to send command to the device

data_description.ip_address: Update if the device IP address changed
data_description.protocol_version: Change only if the device stopped responding after a firmware update
data_description.heartbeat_interval: How often a heartbeat is sent to keep the connection alive (5–300 s, default 20)
data_description.command_timeout: How long to wait for a command response before giving up (1–30 s, default 5)
data_description.reconnect_max_delay: Maximum wait between reconnection attempts (10–3600 s, default 300)

auth_failed.title: Authentication failed for {device_name}
auth_failed.description:
The device **{device_name}** is rejecting the connection. The security key is likely wrong — this happens when the device is factory reset or paired again using the Tuya app.

Click **Fix** to enter a new security key.

confirm.title: Update the security key
confirm.description: Go to **Settings → Integrations → Tuya Cloudless → {device_name}** and select **Re-authenticate**.

connectivity.title: Cannot connect to {name}
connectivity.description:
Unable to reach device at {ip_address} after multiple attempts. The device may have changed IP address.

Click **Fix** to update the connection settings.

confirm.title: Update connection settings
confirm.description: Click **Submit** to open the reconfigure dialog where you can update the IP address and local key. Alternatively, go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Tuya Cloudless → [your device] → Configure**.
